# Configuration reference

Every setting of `config.yaml`, generated from the pydantic schema (`src/osv/config/schema.py`). `osv init DIR` writes a template with the same descriptions as comments; `osv config show` prints the settings in use. Unknown keys are errors. Relative paths are resolved against the directory containing the config file, and `${VAR}` / `${VAR:-default}` are expanded from the environment.

Types: *list[[lower, upper]]* is a list of two-number pairs; *[lat/lon]* is a `[latitude, longitude]` pair in degrees; *null* means the key may be unset. Nested sections are written as YAML mappings; entries marked `[]` are lists of mappings.

| Section | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`project`](#project) | Project identity and run-wide settings. |
| [`inputs`](#inputs) | Input data files and how to read them. |
| [`coordinates`](#coordinates) | Coordinate system. |
| [`data_selection`](#data_selection) | Event and pick selection (Stage 1). |
| [`velest`](#velest) | VELEST Monte Carlo 1-D inversion (Stage 2). |
| [`model3d`](#model3d) | 3-D starting model (Stage 3). |
| [`fmtomo`](#fmtomo) | FMTOMO inversion (Stage 4). |
| [`analysis`](#analysis) | Analysis of the inversion (Stage 5). |
| [`resolution`](#resolution) | Resolution tests (Stage 6). |
| [`validation`](#validation) | Validation relocation (Stage 7). |
| [`plotting`](#plotting) | Figure settings. |
| [`report`](#report) | Project report (final stage). |

## `project`

Project identity and run-wide settings.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | `my-project` | - | Short project name (letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'). |
| `workdir` | path | `runs` | path, relative to the config file | Directory under which numbered stage directories are created. |
| `n_jobs` | integer | `-1` | - | Parallel worker processes; -1 uses all CPU cores. |
| `random_seed` | integer | `42` | - | Seed for all random number generators (reproducibility). |

## `inputs`

Input data files and how to read them.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stationxml` | list[path] | `[]` | path, relative to the config file; globs expanded | StationXML files; entries may be glob patterns (expanded by the loader). |
| `quakeml` | list[path] | `[]` | path, relative to the config file; globs expanded | QuakeML catalogue files; entries may be glob patterns. |
| `origin_selection` | string | `preferred` | - | Which origin to use per event: 'preferred', 'latest' or 'by_method:<method id>'. |
| `evaluation_mode` | string | `any` | `any` \| `manual` \| `automatic` | Keep picks with this evaluation mode ('any' keeps all, including unset). |
| `use_arrivals` | boolean | `false` | - | Build travel times from arrivals instead of picks. Keep false when the catalogue's arrivals may be corrupted or duplicated. |
| `weight_source` | string | `uncertainty` | `uncertainty` \| `comment` \| `both` | Where pick weights come from: the pick time uncertainty, a 'wgt = x' comment, or both. |
| `station_aliases` | string \| dict[string, string] \| path | `auto` | `auto`; path, relative to the config file | VELEST needs station codes of at most 4 characters: 'auto' generates aliases, or give an explicit {code: alias} mapping, or a path to a CSV with columns code,alias (or net,sta,alias). |
| `dem` | path \| null | `null` | path, relative to the config file | Optional GeoTIFF DEM used for the surface interface. |

## `coordinates`

Coordinate system.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projection` | string | `local_tm` | - | 'local_tm' (transverse Mercator about the origin) or an EPSG code such as 'epsg:2193'. |
| `borehole_sensors` | string | `use_depth_from_stationxml` | `use_depth_from_stationxml` \| `ignore_depth` | How to treat borehole sensors: use the sensor depth from StationXML, or ignore it. |
| `depth_datum` | string | `sea_level` | `sea_level` \| `surface` \| `reference` | Datum of the catalogue (QuakeML/NLLoc) hypocentre depths. 'sea_level': depth is below mean sea level (NLLoc default when the grid origin is at sea level, even if the grid top is above it); 'surface': depth is below the local ground surface at the epicentre (needs surface elevations from stations or a DEM); 'reference': depth is below the fixed elevation reference_elevation_m. |
| `reference_elevation_m` | number \| null | `null` | - | Elevation (m above sea level, positive up) of the depth datum; required when depth_datum is 'reference' (e.g. 600 for an NLLoc grid top at +0.6 km). |

### `coordinates.origin`

Local-system origin; null uses the centroid of the stations.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lat` | number | *required* | - | Origin latitude, degrees north (negative = south). |
| `lon` | number | *required* | - | Origin longitude, degrees east (negative = west). |

| `min_s` | integer | `0` | >= 0 | Minimum S picks per event. |

| `max_rms` | number | `0.2` | > 0 | Maximum catalogue RMS residual in seconds. |
| `max_epi_dist_km` | number | `25.0` | > 0 | Maximum epicentral distance to a used station, km. |
| `pick_uncertainty_to_weight` | dict[number, integer] | `{0.02: 0, 0.05: 1, 0.1: 2, 0.2: 3}` | - | Map from pick uncertainty upper limit (s) to VELEST weight class (0 best, 4 reject). |

## `velest`

VELEST Monte Carlo 1-D inversion (Stage 2).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `layers_top_km` | list[number] | `[-0.6, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.5]` | min length 1 | Depth to the top of each layer, km (positive down, may be negative above sea level). The default suits a calibration set with the events at 1-5 km and the stations between -0.6 and +0.2 km depth: layers of about 0.5 km down to the events (the rays only cross them steeply, so thinner layers are not resolved) and 1 km below. See 'Choosing layers and damping' in docs/stage2_velest.md. |
| `vp_bounds` | list[[lower, upper]] | `[[1.96, 3.62], [2.8, 4.3], [3.3, 4.8], [3.8, 5.3], [4.23, 5.73], [4.72, 6.09], [5.38, 6.42]]` | min length 1 | [lower, upper] Vp bounds in km/s for each layer (same length as layers_top_km). They only limit the starting models; the inversion may leave them. |
| `vdamp` | number \| list[number] \| string | `auto` | `auto` | VELEST per-layer velocity damping factor (the model file's vdamp; effective damping is damping.vthet * vdamp): a number for all layers, one value per layer, or 'auto' (heavier damping for layers above the deepest station and below the deepest event, see vdamp_auto). |
| `monotonic` | boolean | `true` | - | Require Vp to be non-decreasing with depth in trial models. |
| `n_models` | integer | `1000` | >= 1 | Number of Monte Carlo trial models. |
| `include_reference_model` | boolean | `true` | - | Also write the mid-bounds reference model as trial 'MC_0000'. |
| `sampler` | string | `latin_hypercube` | `latin_hypercube` \| `sobol` \| `uniform` | Sampling scheme for trial velocity models. |
| `ittmax` | integer | `30` | >= 1 | Maximum VELEST iterations per run (also the default of every stage). Real data rarely meets VELEST's own stop rule: 0/40 runs stopped before the limit at 9, 30 or 60, but the median final RMS fell from 0.0945 (9) to 0.0738 (30) and stayed flat beyond. |
| `invertratio` | integer | `1` | >= 0 | VELEST 'invertratio': invert for velocities every N-th iteration. |
| `compact_runs` | boolean | `true` | - | Delete scratch files of successful VELEST runs, keeping the control file, model, main outputs, logs and status (saves disk for large ensembles). |

### `velest.vpvs`

Vp/Vs treatment.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `fixed` | `fixed` \| `sampled` \| `independent_s_model` | 'fixed' uses 'value' and 'sampled' draws one Vp/Vs per model from 'range'; both run VELEST with nsp=3 (S picks used with Vs = Vp/vpvs, only a P model inverted). 'independent_s_model' samples a separate S velocity model (nsp=2). |
| `value` | number \| string | `1.75` | `wadati` | Vp/Vs ratio for mode 'fixed'. 'wadati' uses the Stage 1 Wadati-diagram ratio (prep stage's wadati.json), resolved when Stage 2 starts (osv.velest.workflow.resolve_vpvs). |
| `range` | [number, number] | `[1.65, 1.85]` | - | [min, max] Vp/Vs for mode 'sampled'. |
| `s_bounds` | list[[lower, upper]] \| null | `null` | - | [lower, upper] Vs bounds in km/s per layer for mode 'independent_s_model' (same length as layers_top_km). Default: derived from vp_bounds and 'range' (lower/range[1], upper/range[0]). |

### `velest.vdamp_auto`

Factors used by vdamp: auto.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `near_surface` | number | `10.0` | >= 0, <= 999 | vdamp of layers that start above the deepest station (their velocity trades off with the station delays). |
| `below_events` | number | `3.0` | >= 0, <= 999 | vdamp of layers that start below the deepest hypocentre (sampled by refracted rays only). |

### `velest.hypocentre_perturbation_km`

Starting hypocentre perturbation tests.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `xy` | number | `1.0` | >= 0 | Horizontal perturbation, km. |
| `z` | number | `1.0` | >= 0 | Vertical perturbation, km. |
| `n_tests` | integer | `50` | >= 0 | Number of perturbed relocation tests. |
| `distribution` | string | `uniform` | `uniform` \| `gaussian` | Offset distribution: 'uniform' in [-xy, xy] per horizontal axis and [-z, z] in depth; 'gaussian' with standard deviations xy and z. |

### `velest.damping`

VELEST damping factors.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `othet` | number | `0.01` | >= 0 | Origin-time damping. |
| `xythet` | number | `0.01` | >= 0 | Epicentre damping. |
| `zthet` | number | `0.01` | >= 0 | Depth damping. |
| `vthet` | number | `1.0` | >= 0 | Velocity damping. |
| `stathet` | number | `0.01` | >= 0 | Station-correction damping. |

### `velest.select`

Selection of the preferred model from the ensemble.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | string | `best_percent` | `best_percent` \| `best_n` \| `rms_below` | 'best_percent': best 'value' percent by RMS; 'best_n': best 'value' models; 'rms_below': all models with RMS below 'value' s. |
| `value` | number | `5.0` | > 0 | Percent, count or RMS threshold depending on 'method'. |
| `statistic` | string | `median` | `median` \| `mean` \| `best` | Statistic over the selected models giving the final model. |
| `final_model` | string | `median` | `median` \| `best` \| `closest` \| `iterated` | Which model becomes the final model. 'median': the per-layer 'statistic' of the selected runs; 'best': the single lowest-RMS run; 'closest': the selected run nearest the per-layer statistic (a model VELEST actually produced); 'iterated': the statistic model iterated with VELEST (delays frozen) to a fixed point. The p05-p95 uncertainty is always taken from the selected ensemble. |

### `velest.stages[]`

Damping schedule run sequentially for every trial model; each stage starts from the previous stage's model (and optionally hypocentres and station delays). An empty list runs a single stage with the top-level damping.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | `stage` | min length 1 | Stage name (used in logs and the history table). |
| `othet` | number \| null | `null` | >= 0 | Origin-time damping (None: velest.damping.othet). |
| `xythet` | number \| null | `null` | >= 0 | Epicentre damping (None: velest.damping.xythet). |
| `zthet` | number \| null | `null` | >= 0 | Depth damping (None: velest.damping.zthet). |
| `vthet` | number \| null | `null` | >= 0 | Velocity damping (None: velest.damping.vthet). |
| `stathet` | number \| null | `null` | >= 0 | Station-correction damping (None: velest.damping.stathet). |
| `ittmax` | integer \| null | `null` | >= 1 | Iterations of this stage (None: velest.ittmax). |
| `swtfac` | number \| null | `null` | >= 0 | Weight factor of S readings in this stage (None: the control file value). With nsp = 3 a small value (e.g. 0.01) makes the stage a P-only inversion, which is the consistent way to estimate station delays. |
| `invertratio` | integer \| null | `null` | >= 0 | VELEST 'invertratio' of this stage (None: velest.invertratio). |
| `use_previous_hypocentres` | boolean | `true` | - | Start from the previous stage's relocated hypocentres (velout.cnv). |
| `use_previous_station_corrections` | boolean | `true` | - | Start from the previous stage's station delays (written to the stage's station file; sets iusestacorr = 1 so VELEST reads them). |
| `invert_station_delays` | boolean \| null | `null` | - | Invert for station delays in this stage (VELEST nsinv). None: as the control default (invert). With nsp = 3 (fixed Vp/Vs) the S delay is ptcor * vpvs but S readings contribute no delay partials, so inverting delays with S data weighted makes the RMS erratic (see docs/conventions.md); False holds the delays fixed. |

### `velest.stability`

Stability tests of the final model.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | - | Run the stability tests (hypocentre perturbation, reference-station swap, LVZ). When false only the fixed-model run that gives the final station delays and hypocentres is made. |
| `fixed_vthet` | number | `100000.0` | > 0, <= 10000000.0 | Velocity damping (vthet) that keeps velocities fixed in the fixed-model runs (scale = sqrt(othet/vthet), velest.f SETUNT). 1e5 holds velocities to < 0.01 km/s; values of 1e8 or more overflow VELEST's control-file reader. |
| `reference_stations` | list[string] | `[]` | - | Alternative reference stations (aliases); empty selects them automatically. |
| `n_reference_stations` | integer | `3` | >= 0 | Number of automatically chosen alternative reference stations. |
| `delay_swtfac` | number \| null | `0.01` | >= 0 | With nsp = 3, S readings give no station-delay partials although their residual contains the delay (ptcor * vpvs), so inverting delays with S data weighted makes the RMS climb. Runs that invert delays (the fixed-model delay step, the reference-station test) therefore weight S by this factor; the other tests hold the delays of the fixed-model run fixed. null keeps the S weight and inverts delays in every run (the previous behaviour). |
| `lvz_test` | boolean | `true` | - | Run the low-velocity-layer on/off test. |
| `horizontal_mislocation_warn_km` | number | `0.5` | > 0 | Warn when the mean horizontal mislocation exceeds this (km). |
| `vertical_mislocation_warn_km` | number | `0.5` | > 0 | Warn when the mean vertical mislocation exceeds this (km). |
| `velocity_spread_warn_km_s` | number | `0.2` | > 0 | Warn when a layer's Vp spread over the perturbed free runs exceeds this. |
| `reference_swap_dv_warn_km_s` | number | `0.1` | > 0 | Warn when a reference-station swap changes a layer's Vp by more than this. |

### `velest.reseed`

Reseeded rounds from the best models.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `false` | - | Run reseeded rounds after the first Monte Carlo round. |
| `best_percent` | number | `10.0` | > 0, <= 100 | Percent of the previous round's converged models (lowest RMS) used as seeds. |
| `n_rounds` | integer | `1` | >= 1 | Number of additional (reseeded) rounds. |
| `perturb_vp_km_s` | number | `0.1` | >= 0 | Standard deviation (km/s) of the Gaussian Vp perturbation of each seed model (Vs follows with the seed's Vp/Vs); 0 reuses the seeds unchanged. |
| `n_copies` | integer | `0` | >= 0 | Perturbed copies per seed model; 0 chooses round(100 / best_percent) so the round has about as many models as the first. |
| `inherit_hypocentres` | boolean | `true` | - | Seeds start from their own relocated hypocentres. |
| `inherit_station_corrections` | boolean | `true` | - | Seeds start from their own station delays. |

### `velest.iterate_until`

Repeat VELEST on the final model until changes are negligible.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `max_cycles` | integer | `5` | >= 0 | Maximum number of repeated VELEST runs (0 disables the loop). |
| `model_change_km_s` | number | `0.02` | > 0 | Stop when the largest layer velocity change is below this (km/s). |
| `hypo_change_km` | number | `0.1` | > 0 | Stop when the mean hypocentre shift is below this (km). |
| `drift_warn_km_s` | number | `0.2` | > 0 | Warn when the repeat-until-stable loop moves a layer's Vp from the ensemble final model by more than this (km/s). |

## `model3d`

3-D starting model (Stage 3).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | `velest_1d` | `velest_1d` \| `user_grid` \| `geology` \| `wells` \| `geology+wells` | Origin of the 3-D starting model. |
| `propgrid_refine` | integer | `3` | >= 1 | Forward-grid refinement factor relative to the inversion grid (3: ~3 ms median P travel-time error vs 5, 6x less time, 4x less memory; 2 is ~6 ms, 5 the slow reference). |
| `source_refine_factor` | integer | `5` | >= 1 | fm3d refinement of the grid around each source (propgrid.in line 4). |
| `source_refine_cells` | integer | `5` | >= 1 | Extent of the refined grid around each source, in propagation cells. |
| `surface` | string | `station_elevations` | `dem` \| `flat` \| `station_elevations` | Source of the top (surface) interface. |
| `surface_elevation_m` | number | `0.0` | - | Elevation of the flat surface (surface = 'flat'), m above sea level. |
| `surface_smoothing_km` | number | `1.0` | >= 0 | Gaussian smoothing length of the station-elevation surface (and of the DEM after resampling), km. |
| `station_delays` | string | `diagnostic` | `diagnostic` \| `near_surface_layer` | 'diagnostic': only report station delays; 'near_surface_layer': model them. |
| `apply_velest_station_delays` | boolean | `true` | - | Subtract the Stage 2 VELEST station delays (ptcor/stcor) from the observed travel times written for FMTOMO. FMTOMO cannot invert for station terms, so on (default) the station-scale near-surface signal, which the 3-D grid cannot resolve, is removed using the minimum 1-D model's delays (on rk-nm-2017 station mean residuals correlate with VELEST delays at r=0.92). Off: the 3-D model must explain the delays itself, which maps them into the shallowest nodes (rk-nm-2017 A/B: without delays the dVp std rises from 2.7 to 8.3 % with up to 50 % near-surface anomalies and the validation gain over 1-D drops; keep on). |
| `velest_station_delays_exclude` | list[string] \| string | `[]` | `borehole` | Stations whose VELEST delays are NOT subtracted when apply_velest_station_delays is on: a list of station codes/aliases, or 'borehole' (all stations with a sensor depth > 0). Their delays are relative to the reference station and may double-count the sensor depth. 'borehole' on rk-nm-2017 lowered the borehole station residuals a little but moved them into +10 % near-surface anomalies; default: none. |
| `uncertainty_from_weight` | boolean | `false` | - | Increase the a priori uncertainty where the user model's weight is low (factor uncertainty_low_weight_factor at weight 0, capped by extrusion max_km_s). |
| `uncertainty_low_weight_factor` | number | `2.0` | >= 1 | Uncertainty multiplier at zero user-model weight (uncertainty_from_weight). |

| `surface` | path | *required* | path, relative to the config file | Base surface file (XYZ, GeoTIFF or GOCAD TSurf). |
| `vpvs` | number | `1.75` | > 1.0 | Vp/Vs ratio used when no S-velocity law is given. |
| `crs` | string \| null | `null` | - | CRS of the surface file (e.g. 'EPSG:2193'); null = file's own CRS or lon/lat. |
| `z_convention` | string | `depth` | `depth` \| `elevation` | Surface z values are depth (positive down) or elevation (positive up). |
| `units` | string | `m` | `m` \| `km` | Unit of the surface z values. |

##### `model3d.user_model.horizons[].vp`

P-velocity law within the unit.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `law` | string | *required* | `constant` |  |
| `v0` | number | *required* | > 0 | Velocity, km/s. |

##### `model3d.user_model.horizons[].vs`

Optional S-velocity law; default uses the Vp/Vs ratio.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `law` | string | *required* | `constant` |  |
| `v0` | number | *required* | > 0 | Velocity, km/s. |

#### `model3d.user_model.wells`

Well-log constraints.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `las_dir` | path \| null | `null` | path, relative to the config file | Directory of LAS well logs; null disables wells. |
| `table` | path \| null | `null` | path, relative to the config file | Wells table CSV: columns name, las_file, x/y (or lon/lat), elevation_m (elevation of the depth datum above sea level) and optional deviation_file (MD, inclination, azimuth). Null = take locations from the LAS headers. |
| `crs` | string \| null | `null` | - | CRS of the table x/y (e.g. 'EPSG:2193'); null = lon/lat. |
| `curve` | string | `DT` | min length 1 | Log curve mnemonic to convert (sonic slowness). |
| `shear_curve` | string \| null | `DTS` | - | Shear sonic slowness curve mnemonic; null = none. |
| `density_curve` | string \| null | `RHOB` | - | Bulk density curve for Backus averaging; absent = Gardner's relation. |
| `depth_reference` | string | `KB` | `KB` \| `GL` \| `MSL` | Datum of the log depths: kelly bushing, ground level (both at 'elevation_m' above sea level) or mean sea level. |
| `units` | string | `auto` | `auto` \| `us/ft` \| `us/m` | Units of the sonic slowness curves. |
| `smoothing_m` | number | `50.0` | >= 0 | Vertical smoothing length applied to logs, m. |
| `despike_window_m` | number | `2.0` | >= 0 | Median-filter window used to remove spikes, m (0 = off). |
| `despike_threshold` | number | `5.0` | > 0 | Spike threshold in median absolute deviations. |
| `upscale` | string | `backus` | `backus` \| `average` \| `none` | Upscaling to the model dz: Backus, slowness average or point sampling. |
| `vpvs` | number | `1.75` | > 1.0 | Vp/Vs used where no shear log exists. |
| `interp` | string | `kriging` | `kriging` \| `idw` \| `nearest` \| `linear` | Interpolation of well velocities between wells ('linear' is an alias of idw). |
| `idw_power` | number | `2.0` | > 0 | Inverse-distance weighting power. |
| `max_distance_km` | number | `10.0` | > 0 | Distance from the nearest well beyond which the background is used. |
| `taper_km` | number | `2.0` | >= 0 | Width of the taper to the background inside max_distance_km. |

##### `model3d.user_model.wells.variogram`

Variogram used by kriging.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | `spherical` | `spherical` \| `exponential` \| `gaussian` | Variogram model. |
| `range_km` | number | `10.0` | > 0 | Variogram range (practical range for exponential), km. |
| `sill` | number | `1.0` | > 0 | Sill (kriging weights only depend on nugget/sill ratio). |
| `nugget` | number | `0.0` | >= 0 | Nugget (same units as the sill). |

### `model3d.checks`

Physical checks of the starting model.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vp_min_km_s` | number | `1.0` | > 0 | Vp below this is flagged, km/s. |
| `vp_max_km_s` | number | `8.5` | > 0 | Vp above this is flagged, km/s. |
| `vpvs_min` | number | `1.4` | > 0 | Vp/Vs below this is flagged. |
| `vpvs_max` | number | `2.2` | > 0 | Vp/Vs above this is flagged. |
| `max_gradient_km_s_per_km` | number | `3.0` | > 0 | Velocity gradient magnitude above this is flagged, (km/s)/km. |

## `fmtomo`

FMTOMO inversion (Stage 4).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `package` | string | `extras` | `base` \| `extras` | 'base' FMTOMO or the patched 'extras' variant. |
| `phases` | list[string] | `[P]` | `P` \| `S` \| `vpvs`; min length 1 | Phases to invert: [P], [P, S] (coupling set by joint.relocation), or [vpvs] (P and S inversions followed by the Vp/Vs inversion; needs relocate: nonlinear). |
| `relocate` | string | `nonlinear` | `none` \| `linear` \| `nonlinear` | Event relocation during inversion ('nonlinear' uses gridloc). |
| `iterations` | integer | `6` | >= 1 | Non-linear inversion iterations. |
| `damping` | number | `50.0` | >= 0 | Damping (used when not running the trade-off). |
| `smoothing` | number | `100.0` | >= 0 | Smoothing (used when not running the trade-off). |
| `subspace_dimension` | integer | `20` | >= 1, <= 50 | Subspace dimension of invert3d (raised to the number of parameter classes). |
| `invert_velocity` | boolean | `true` | - | Invert for velocity (False: relocation only). |
| `invert_interfaces` | list[integer] | `[]` | - | 1-based ids of interfaces whose depth is inverted (empty: none). |
| `source_damping_position` | number | `1.0` | >= 0 | Relative damping of linear source position updates (invert3d damp1). |
| `source_damping_time` | number | `1.0` | >= 0 | Relative damping of linear origin-time updates (invert3d damp2). |
| `source_uncertainty_km` | number | `1.0` | > 0 | A priori hypocentre uncertainty (depth and horizontal, km) written to sources.in for linear relocation; invert3d damps source updates by it. |
| `min_velocity_km_s` | number | `0.5` | > 0 | Minimum velocity permitted by invert3d, km/s. |
| `min_interface_distance_km` | number | `0.07` | >= 0 | Minimum distance between interfaces kept by invert3d, km. |
| `save_rays` | boolean | `true` | - | Save ray paths (rays.dat) in the forward runs. |
| `station_terms` | string | `none` | `none` \| `preapply` | FMTOMO has no station terms. 'preapply' subtracts per-station mean residuals (supplied to assemble_run_dir) from the observed times before inversion. |

### `fmtomo.tradeoff`

Trade-off sweep settings.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `damping` | list[number] | `[1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500]` | - | Damping values to test. |
| `smoothing` | list[number] | `[1, 10, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000]` | - | Smoothing values to test. |
| `mode` | string | `sequential` | `sequential` \| `full_grid` | 'sequential': sweep damping then smoothing; 'full_grid': all combinations. |
| `pick` | string | `max_curvature` | `max_curvature` \| `manual` | How to choose the preferred values from the L-curve. |
| `iterations` | integer | `3` | >= 1 | Inversion iterations of each trade-off run (fewer than the final inversion). |
| `max_concurrent` | integer \| null | `null` | >= 1 | Trade-off inversions run at the same time (None: n_jobs // 8, at least 1); the fm3d jobs are split between them. |

### `fmtomo.gridloc`

Nonlinear relocation (Extras gridloc) settings.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min_stations` | integer | `5` | >= 1 | Do not relocate events with fewer picks than this. |
| `max_origin_time_shift_s` | number | `5.0` | > 0 | Maximum origin-time perturbation, s. |
| `refine` | boolean | `true` | - | Refine the minimum with a trilinear sub-cell search. |
| `subcell_dicing` | integer | `10` | >= 2 | Sub-cell dicing of the refined search (must be > 1). |

### `fmtomo.joint`

Joint P+S / Vp/Vs (experimental, Extras tomo3dj and tomo3dps).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `s_weight` | number | `3.0` | > 0 | gridlocj: S weight (higher = S times count less). |
| `sp_weight` | number | `100.0` | > 0 | gridlocj: weight of S-P residuals. |
| `relocation_based_on` | literal | `1` | `1` \| `2` \| `3` \| `4` | gridlocj: 1 P only, 2 P + unique S, 3 P + S-P + unique S, 4 P and S. |
| `vpvs_max_depth_km` | number | `50.0` | > 0 | mkvpvs: maximum depth of the Vp/Vs model, km. |
| `sparse_fraction` | number | `0.1` | > 0 | vpvsinv: fraction of max G size for the sparse matrix. |
| `relocation` | string \| null | `null` | `joint` \| `p_fixed_for_s` \| `independent` | How P and S share the hypocentres when both phases are inverted: 'joint' (coupled gridlocj relocation, Extras tomo3dj), 'p_fixed_for_s' (relocate with P, keep those hypocentres fixed in the S run) or 'independent' (separate runs). None: 'joint' for phases [vpvs], 'independent' for [P, S]. All modes but 'independent' (and [vpvs]) need relocate: nonlinear. Example: `joint` |

## `analysis`

Analysis of the inversion (Stage 5).

### `analysis.qc`

QC thresholds of the checks.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min_variance_reduction_pct` | number | `10.0` | - | Warn when the inversion reduces the data variance by less than this (%). |
| `moved_km` | number | `1.0` | > 0 | Hypocentre shift that counts as 'moved' (km). |
| `max_moved_fraction` | number | `0.25` | >= 0, <= 1 | Warn when more than this fraction of events moved by over moved_km. |
| `max_change_outside_coverage_pct` | number | `10.0` | > 0 | Warn when more than 5% of the nodes without ray coverage changed by over this (%). |
| `min_covered_fraction` | number | `0.05` | >= 0, <= 1 | Warn when the covered volume fraction is below this. |

## `resolution`

Resolution tests (Stage 6).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_models` | list[string] | `[final_3d, user_model]` | `final_3d` \| `user_model` \| `starting` \| `file` \| `anomaly` | Models used as the test background. |
| `input_model_file` | path \| null | `null` | path, relative to the config file | NetCDF/CSV velocity grid for the 'file' input model. |

### `resolution.checkerboard`

Checkerboard test settings.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cell_km` | list[number] | `[1.5, 2.0, 3.0]` | - | Cell sizes to test, km. |
| `amplitude_pct` | number | `5.0` | > 0, < 100 | Velocity perturbation amplitude, percent. |
| `offset_half_cell` | boolean | `true` | - | Also run a copy offset by half a cell. |
| `shape` | string | `sin` | `sin` \| `block` | Pattern shape: smooth sinusoid (recommended for B-spline grids) or sign blocks. |
| `depth_cells` | boolean | `true` | - | Alternate in depth as well (3-D); false = laterally varying only, constant in depth. |

### `resolution.spikes[]`

Spike tests.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x_km` | number | *required* | - | East offset from origin, km. |
| `y_km` | number | *required* | - | North offset from origin, km. |
| `z_km` | number | *required* | - | Depth, km. |
| `radius_km` | number | *required* | > 0 | Spike radius, km. |
| `pct` | number | *required* | - | Velocity perturbation, percent. |
| `shape` | string | `gaussian` | `gaussian` \| `sphere` | Gaussian (sigma = radius/2) or uniform sphere. |

### `resolution.anomalies[]`

Custom anomaly bodies for the 'anomaly' input model.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | *required* | `block` \| `cylinder` \| `slab` | Body type. |
| `x_km` | number | *required* | - | East offset of the body centre from the origin, km. |
| `y_km` | number | *required* | - | North offset of the body centre, km. |
| `z_km` | number | *required* | - | Depth of the body centre, km. |
| `pct` | number | *required* | - | Velocity perturbation, percent. |
| `length_km` | number | `2.0` | > 0 | Extent along strike, km (block, slab, cylinder axis). |
| `width_km` | number | `2.0` | > 0 | Extent across strike (block) or down dip (slab), km. |
| `height_km` | number | `2.0` | > 0 | Vertical extent (block), km. |
| `thickness_km` | number | `0.5` | > 0 | Slab thickness normal to the plane, km. |
| `radius_km` | number | `1.0` | > 0 | Cylinder radius, km. |
| `strike_deg` | number | `0.0` | - | Strike, degrees clockwise from north. |
| `dip_deg` | number | `90.0` | >= 0, <= 90 | Dip below horizontal, degrees (right-hand rule). |
| `edge_km` | number | `0.0` | >= 0 | Width of the smooth (cosine) edge taper, km (0 = hard edge). |

### `resolution.noise`

Noise added to synthetic data.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_pick_uncertainty` | boolean | `true` | - | Scale noise to each pick's uncertainty. |
| `scale` | number | `1.0` | >= 0 | Noise scale factor. |
| `sigma_s` | number | `0.02` | >= 0 | Constant noise sigma, s, used when from_pick_uncertainty is false. |

### `resolution.hypocentre_noise_km`

Perturbation of the starting hypocentres of the test inversions.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `xy` | number | `0.0` | >= 0 | Gaussian sigma of each horizontal coordinate, km (0 = true positions). |
| `z` | number | `0.0` | >= 0 | Gaussian sigma of the depth, km (0 = true depths). |

### `resolution.mask`

Recovery thresholds of the resolvable mask.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `min_corr` | number | `0.5` | >= -1, <= 1 | Minimum local correlation (true vs recovered). |
| `min_amplitude` | number | `0.3` | >= 0 | Minimum local amplitude recovery (regression slope). |
| `window_km` | number \| null | `null` | > 0 | Full width of the Gaussian moving window, km (null = the checkerboard cell size of each test). |
| `combine_with_dws` | boolean | `true` | - | AND the resolvable mask with the DWS coverage mask. |

## `validation`

Validation relocation (Stage 7).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | - | Run the validation relocation (needs events with split 'validation'). |
| `max_iterations` | integer | `5` | >= 1 | Gauss-Newton iterations of the 3-D relocation. |
| `n_jobs` | integer \| null | `null` | >= 1 | Parallel fm3d processes (None: project.n_jobs, at most 8). |
| `use_s` | boolean \| null | `null` | - | Use S picks as well as P (None: when fmtomo.phases has S). Example: `false` |
| `source_sigma_km` | number | `2.0` | > 0 | A priori hypocentre standard deviation (damping), km. |
| `velest_ittmax` | integer | `20` | >= 1 | VELEST iterations per event for the 1-D relocation. |
| `worse_fraction_warn` | number | `0.5` | >= 0, <= 1 | Warn when 3-D fits worse than 1-D for more than this fraction of events. |
| `min_events_stat` | integer | `6` | >= 1 | Fewer paired events than this makes the statistical test informational. |
| `improve_tol_ms` | number | `0.5` | >= 0 | RMS changes below this (ms) count as a tie. |
| `max_hypo_shift_warn_km` | number | `5.0` | > 0 | Warn when the 1-D to 3-D hypocentre shift exceeds this (km). |

### `validation.bootstrap`

Bootstrap / jackknife model uncertainty.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed / constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `false` | - | Run the bootstrap/jackknife inversions (slow: one inversion each). |
| `method` | string | `bootstrap` | `bootstrap` \| `jackknife` | bootstrap: events drawn with replacement; jackknife: delete-d resampling of events. |
| `n_samples` | integer | `20` | >= 2 | Resampled inversions (jackknife: at most one per event for leave-one-out). |
| `seed` | integer \| null | `null` | - | Resampling seed (None: project.random_seed). |
| `max_concurrent` | integer \| null | `null` | >= 1 | Inversions run at the same time (None: n_jobs // 4, at least 1). |
| `iterations` | integer \| null | `null` | >= 1 | Iterations per inversion (None: fmtomo.iterations). |
| `delete_fraction` | number | `0.1` | > 0, < 1 | Jackknife: fraction of the events deleted in each sample. |
| `interval_percent` | number | `90.0` | > 0, < 100 | Width (percent) of the central interval reported for every node. |
| `min_free_disk_gb` | number | `1.0` | >= 0 | Do not start an inversion with less free disk (GB). |
| `min_ok_fraction` | number | `0.8` | >= 0, <= 1 | Warn when fewer than this fraction of the resampled inversions succeeded. |
| `std_warn_pct` | number | `3.0` | > 0 | Warn when the median velocity-perturbation std inside the DWS coverage exceeds this (percent). |
